findings.evidence: The end frame connects Sender → Service → Storage, but neither arrow is labeled, so the request and the information sent to storage are not explicitly distinguished.
findings.suggestion: Label the Sender-to-Service arrow “Request” and the Service-to-Storage arrow “Information,” retaining the existing direction and service emphasis.
